text: This report presents recommended updates to the Terms of Reference for the Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Grants and Programs, Human Resources, and Audit Committees. The proposed updates align with the requirements of Toronto Atmospheric Fund By-law No. 1, reflect current governance practices and mandates of the committees, and improve clarity and consistency by referencing (rather than duplicating) provisions in other governing documents.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the updated Terms of Reference for the Grants and Programs, Human Resources, and Audit Committees, as set out in Attachments 1 to 3 to the report (June 26, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund.
